calls.title: Jennifer Pham-Le and Scout Henderson
calls.summary: The session detailed the process for automated employee onboarding in the UK under EOR, emphasizing statutory requirements for vacation, attendance, and pension contributions, which start on the employee’s first day with no eligibility delays. It outlined that while employers can exceed the minimum pension contributions, they must adhere to the 3% legal minimum and employees can opt out through HR. About half of UK employers offer fully employer-funded private health insurance, with Allianz and BUPA as prominent providers. The automatic PTO setup includes 20 days plus bank holidays, with unused days not rolling over. Lastly, it confirmed that the employee is ready for payroll, having completed the necessary banking and tax information, and highlighted ongoing support for policy management and compliance.
calls.keywords: EOR, UK pension, benefits setup, PTO policy, Rippling payroll, time off approval
